items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We had Tommy Young, as I mentioned, for awhile there.

ctx.x: Who was responsible for that conversion from the CBS which had no black musicians at all -- do you remember who was responsible for that?
Well, Raymond Scott must have had with this band, a great deal to do with it. We had Tommy Young, as I mentioned, for awhile there.
That was CBS. Do you think CBS might have had something to do with that?
